annotations.text:
Two directions for the same product — pick one and I'll build it into the real UI.

A — Mission Control: dark, dense, operator-grade. Built for someone watching several bots at once.
B — Studio: light, editorial, calm. Built for someone with a handful of bots who wants it to feel effortless.
The two flows that carry the product: describing a bot (with vault-locked keys) and living inside one bot's history.
